12 folds, 6 years — not a cherry-picked 3-fold split

Diebold-Mariano Test Result
p < 0.05
Tree-based models are statistically superior to Holt-Winters, with Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold small-sample correction applied.
Why 12 folds? The original baseline used only 3 folds (2019–2021), creating regime bias. 12 folds covering 6 full years reveals true model stability across economic cycles.

🔍 Outlier Autopsy — 2022-11-09
Revenue dropped 70% in one day. Investigation confirmed an exogenous supply chain stoppage, not model drift. Model self-corrected within 24 hours.
Recommended Cadence
Quarterly full retrain with monthly feature calibration. High-frequency retraining overfit transient noise during volatile periods.
